proposed_analysis_parameters.status: Exploratory ranges only; not approved reserves, calibrated parameters or engineering selections
proposed_analysis_parameters.density_note: Proposed atmosphere sensitivity; vendor test density unavailable, so do not apply a purported validated density correction.
proposed_analysis_parameters.torque_model_boundary: For identifiability and sensitivity only: Q_i=kQ_i*ell_i*T_iso_i, T_i=kT_i*T_iso_i. ell_i and kQ_i are not inferred from battery current or KV. Solve collective and aerodynamic torque balance simultaneously; evaluate both signs of differential yaw at unchanged collective. Results cannot establish measured yaw authority.
proposed_analysis_parameters.interpolation: Piecewise-linear within supplied table range only. Unsupported demands reported, never silently clamped or extrapolated. Current measurement boundary and ESC used in vendor tests remain unknown.
proposed_analysis_parameters.response_boundary: Uncalibrated study parameters; ESC acceleration menu durations are not these time constants. Realizable throttle protocol and loaded response need separate implementation and tests.
proposed_analysis_parameters.battery_boundary: No sourced discharge/resistance map or approved cutoff. Treat usable fraction as terminal-energy fraction inclusive of internal losses; do not subtract I-squared-R energy again. Thevenin voltage calculations are sensitivity cases, not an SOC-resolved validated mission battery. Off-test-voltage thrust mapping is unsupported and must be labelled as an additional assumption, not calibrated performance.
proposed_analysis_parameters.auxiliary_boundary: Whole auxiliary battery-bus allowances, including controllers, sensing, receiver, both loaded servos and conversion losses. Do not add component power again. BEC output current is not battery current; peak duration and regulator compatibility remain separate checks.

mission_energy_proxy.method: Add stage integrals. Climb proxy uses hover electrical power plus m*g*height/efficiency over the climb; descent receives no regenerative or induced-power credit. Acquisition uses hover power. Spool-up uses the stated mean fraction; settling uses hover power conservatively. Add auxiliary bus energy over all stages. This is a sizing proxy, not a simulated trajectory or proof of acquisition, touchdown or settling.
mission_energy_proxy.transient_boundary: Rotor inertias and loaded speed history unavailable: explicit rotor spin-up/transient electrical correction remains unresolved rather than asserted covered by calibrated data. Report this limitation alongside every proxy result.

proposed_analysis_parameters.thermal_boundary: SunnySky 40 A for 30 s and Himax 20 A per rotor for 15 s do not qualify 300-second hover. Record current ratios and durations, but thermal qualification remains unperformed. Integrated branch performance remains unavailable without its own map.
